prompt:
Hi, I'm the marketing lead at DataViz Pro. We're about to launch our KOL influencer outreach campaign and I need you to set up our email marketing system completely from scratch.

Here's what we have ready on the Desktop:
- `邮件文案.txt` — our final campaign copy in plain text
- `raw_faq_data.txt` — a messy dump of customer Q&A from our support team that needs cleaning up
- `邮标题.txt` — the subject line
- `邮箱.xlsx` — our contact list

What I need you to do:
1. Turn the plain-text copy into a proper HTML email file called `邮件内容.html` and save it to the Desktop. It needs to look great on mobile and desktop, and the personalization markers in the copy must be preserved exactly as-is so the system can fill them in for each recipient later.
2. Clean up the `raw_faq_data.txt` into a properly formatted knowledge base file called `faq.txt` and save it to the Desktop. Use the format that the auto-reply system expects — don't include anything that the notes say should NOT be in the knowledge base.
3. Make sure the statistics reporting works end-to-end. The send logs and reply data are already in `email-marketing/assets/`. Run the reporting tool and confirm the system is reading the FAQ correctly.

The email marketing scripts are already installed under `email-marketing/scripts/`. Please get everything working so that when I come back, the whole pipeline is operational.
